configuration_constraints.expected_value: The solution is classified as combining knowledge capture and knowledge synthesis.
A GAIK Transcriber capability processes the WAV recording and preserves timestamps suitable for citations.
acceptable_alternatives: an approved GAIK audio module that includes timestamped transcription
forbidden_combinations: audio processed only as an unparsed binary attachment

configuration_constraints.expected_value: A GAIK document parser processes the PDF agenda and preserves page provenance.
acceptable_alternatives: Document Parser configured for PDF and page metadata
forbidden_combinations: agenda treated as plain unreferenced text

configuration_constraints.expected_value: A GAIK Extractor or equivalent schema-guided capability produces the required meeting-record JSON.
acceptable_alternatives: Data Extractor within a configured module
forbidden_combinations: free-form report generation without schema validation

configuration_constraints.expected_value: The solution combines transcript, agenda, and participant evidence through Multi-Source Report Generator or a traceable composition of GAIK components without redundant overlapping pipelines.
acceptable_alternatives: Transcriber plus Document Parser plus Extractor with an explicit merge or synthesis step
forbidden_combinations: duplicate standalone and module pipelines performing the same extraction
parallel outputs without a defined merge

configuration_constraints.expected_value: The configuration accepts one English bundle containing WAV, PDF, and participant JSON and resolves all paths relative to the bundle.
The output schema includes meeting metadata, participants, topics, decisions, actions with nullable owner and due date, unresolved issues, conflicts, citations, and pending review status.
forbidden_combinations: required fabricated owner or due date defaults

configuration_constraints.expected_value: Prompts or configuration enforce audio timestamp citations, PDF page citations, spoken-decision precedence, explicit conflict recording, and no unsupported facts.
acceptable_alternatives: equivalent deterministic post-processing plus prompt rules
forbidden_combinations: agenda proposals automatically promoted to decisions

configuration_constraints.expected_value: The workflow orders upload, transcription and parsing, participant normalization, multi-source synthesis, structured validation, manager review, and approve-or-return; the PoC is a CLI that accepts the bundle and outputs JSON.
acceptable_alternatives: parallel transcription and parsing before an explicit merge, followed by the same review sequence
forbidden_combinations: PoC requiring the web application or external integrations
